title: Weight-only INT8 conformance pipeline and calibration contracts for GPTQ/AWQ
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Build an automated conformance pipeline that validates INT8 weight-only quantization artifacts produced by GPTQ and AWQ flows. This ticket scopes the integration glue, the canonical calibration contract (inputs/outputs/metrics), and a set of lightweight fidelity checks that run on PRs and nightly builds. The goal is to detect accuracy regressions early without running full E2E large-scale evals: fast, deterministic checks that exercise calibration parameters, per-layer scale stability, and representative prompt families. Deliverables include: CI jobs that produce a provenance bundle (model hash, quant config, calibration matrix), a telemetry schema for calibration drift signals, and a small golden question set with expected tolerances for quality and logits-level divergence.

Why: We repeatedly see small calibration config changes (per-tensor vs per-channel, clip strategy, bias correction) cause subtle drift in downstream metrics. Existing testbeds are slow and noisy. A conformance pipeline with well-defined contracts lets model engineers and runtime owners merge changes with measurable risk, gives on-call early warning, and feeds rollback/mitigation automation in the console.

Scope exclusions: This ticket does not implement heavy-weight full-eval suites, nor does it replace nightly large-model fidelity sweeps; it aims to be the fast guardrail for integration and PR validation.
acceptance_criteria: CI produces a quantization provenance bundle for every GPTQ/AWQ pipeline run: model_id, base_fp_model_hash, quant_config_id, calibration_snapshot_id, timestamp

A calibration contract spec document (markdown) that enumerates required inputs (calibration dataset sampling, bitwidth flags, quant granularity) and outputs (scale tensors, zero points if used, per-layer stats) is checked into repo
Three CI jobs implemented: fast-smoke (per-commit), integration-smoke (daily), and provenance-archive (on tagged builds). Each job returns pass/fail and uploads artifacts to the artifacts bucket
A golden question set of ~120 prompts with per-prompt tolerance thresholds is added; failures are triaged and produce a summarized report with per-prompt delta and recommended mitigation
Telemetry emitted for calibration drift metrics: avg KL per-layer, max token-level logit diff, percent prompts exceeding tolerance. Schema registered and dashboards wired to console telemetry
Documentation for runtime fallback behaviors when conformance fails: automatic rollback to last-known-good quant config or switch to a slightly higher-precision profile
Performance: fast-smoke CI completes within 25 minutes on the standard CI pool and has deterministic seeds to reduce flakiness
test_plan: Unit tests for the provenance bundle serializer and checksum verification
Integration test that runs GPTQ and AWQ libraries on a small model shard and verifies the quant artifacts conform to the calibration contract
Deterministic smoke harness that runs the golden question set and records logits and token deltas; compare to golden snapshot within tolerances
Chaos test (optional for nightly integration): random seed perturbation and input jitter to detect brittle calibration heuristics
Performance gate: measure CI wall time and ensure median < 25 min for fast-smoke job
implementation_steps: Define calibration contract RFC and land as README in /quant/provenance/
Implement provenance bundle generator in quant-pipeline service (metadata, checksums, small JSON manifest)
Create fast-smoke CI job: container image, deterministic seed, limited sample size, upload artifacts
Add golden question set (reviewed by QA and applied-ML) and establish baseline snapshots for both GPTQ and AWQ flows
Wire telemetry: emit calibration metrics to metrics gateway and add minimal dashboard tile in console
Integrate CI job into PR gating for quant pipeline repo and add opt-in label for model PRs
Document rollback and fallback behavior and add a runbook for on-call responders
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): run fast-smoke locally and in feature branch runs for 1 week
Phase 2 (staged CI): enable fast-smoke in main CI pipeline for quant-* repos; collect metrics and adjust tolerances over 2 weeks
Phase 3 (blocked PR gating): enable pass/fail gating for low-risk config changes; escalate to integration-smoke for higher-risk changes
Phase 4 (nightly): enable integration-smoke daily job and archive provenance bundles to long-term storage
monitoring_and_alerting: Alert on sudden uptick in percent-prompts-exceeding-tolerance > 2% in a 1h window
Alert if provenance bundle generation fails or artifact upload returns non-200
Dashboard: per-model family heatmap of avg KL per-layer and token-level median logit diff
